note: Medicine Bow NF, Pole Mountain unit, among the granite boulders and cliffs of the Vedauwoo formation about 16 mi E of Laramie off I-80 (exit 329). Two loops in limber pine, spruce and aspen; rock climbing and the Turtle Rock trail from camp. Hand-pump water in the north loop (sites 19-29), usually July to September. Vehicles must stay on the pavement. --Claude
